### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/connector-app-docusign`, touching **58** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/apps/connector-docusign/README.md`, `packages/apps/connector-docusign/assets/icon.svg`, `packages/apps/connector-docusign/objectstack.config.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**65** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/apps/connector-docusign/README.md`, `packages/apps/connector-docusign/assets/icon.svg`, `packages/apps/connector-docusign/objectstack.config.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sharingModel (symbol, 47 pages)`
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `66b4ddcad6b548235855a5615ab9d6b5dec66699` — the merge of head `a7e2abd1d461730ee8da94e6cebbc3c06aa8d5ff` into base `b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 66b4ddcad6b548235855a5615ab9d6b5dec66699 && git checkout 66b4ddcad6b548235855a5615ab9d6b5dec66699
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745 a7e2abd1d461730ee8da94e6cebbc3c06aa8d5ff && git checkout -B drift-repro b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745 && git merge --no-ff a7e2abd1d461730ee8da94e6cebbc3c06aa8d5ff

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs b0ef25f524b870433424b8ad797ef3801374f745` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

domain:server#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXKRzgnVvjzxaYxLUf

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增开源版 DocuSign 连接器应用 `packages/apps/connector-docusign`（私有元数据包）：DocuSign eSignature 官方 OpenAPI 文档离线裁成三个信封操作，OAuth `authorization_code` 由各部署管理员自带集成密钥（`clientSource: 'installer'`），另含信封对象、列表视图与三个流程（发送、读取、轮询状态）。
- 为什么改：#27223 的 HotCLM 代理需要 DocuSign；#28702 裁决 B 落地后，OAuth 应用可以不带任何 ObjectStack 密钥上架，这是该路径的第一个声明式验证。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个私有包，另改一个 spec 一致性测试（带 `objectstack.manifest.json` 的可安装应用包不计入平台对象清单）；不改平台运行代码，回滚即 revert。仓库里没有任何密钥。
- 先看：`src/connectors/docusign.connector.ts` 与 README 的 Credentials、Callbacks 两节。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。沙箱真机往返本容器测不到（网络策略 403），留给验收跑。
- 席位意见：文档按 Stripe 先例裁到 `--max-depth 0`，PR 留在 3000 行以内；深度 2 会到 6130 行、转人工合并，换来的只是发送信封的请求体由类型桩变成完整结构。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · `domain:server#2` · head `a7e2abd1d461730ee8da94e6cebbc3c06aa8d5ff` · 2026-11-03T06:54Z · seat review of record at `TIER_DEFAULT` (not governed: `check-governed-merges --pr 29813` 0 of 17 paths; `Clause-②: no`; `skip-changeset`, private package; the one `packages/spec` path is a conformance test, no schema file; no contract face, so no second agent)

1. **Shape:** draft, base `main`, `Fixes #28277`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` (`"private": true`). 17 files, +2911/-12, 2923 changed lines (under the 3000 human-merge threshold). Package `@objectstack/connector-app-docusign`, named like `@objectstack/connector-app-stripe`; `check-package-naming` exit 0. Seat read the connector: `provider: 'openapi'`, `include` = the three operations (`Envelopes_PostEnvelopes`, `Envelopes_GetEnvelope`, `Envelopes_GetEnvelopes`), sandbox `baseUrl` `demo.docusign.net`, `auth` `oauth2` `authorization_code` against `account-d.docusign.com` with `scopes: ['signature']` and `clientSource: 'installer'` (the #28864/#28866 shape on main), no `clientId`, no `credentialRef`, no key value anywhere: ruling B (6566728470) held.
2. **Premise measured:** every `Blocked-by:` closed; the eSignature document is `docusign/OpenAPI-Specifications` (MIT, LICENSE packaged); the depth-2 run re-derived the epic seat's sha `e1051eb4…961d`; the packaged cut is `--max-depth 0`, the Stripe precedent, recorded with its sha in the README. Seat call on the deviation: depth 0 accepted by that precedent (the cost is a typed stub for the PostEnvelopes body; the eval's three operations all materialize).
3. **Gates on this head:** check-runs pinned to `a7e2abd1`: 65 total, 57 success, 8 skipped, 0 failed (Test Core 2/8 was red on `d9a09f83`: the spec platform-object-name conformance scan counted `docusign_envelope` as a platform object). Dev: 62/62 derived families exit 0, `--ran` reconciled, `pnpm lint` 0; `os validate` green; vitest 27/27, the boot test driving the installer-client connect against a fake DocuSign.
4. **The scanner fix (`a7e2abd1`, `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts` +73/-9):** the exclusion is keyed on the package's own `objectstack.manifest.json` listing, not on `packages/apps/`, so the platform apps `account`, `setup`, `studio` stay scanned; a lit control proves `docusign_envelope` is seen and kept out, and a new guard refuses any installable app object under a reserved platform prefix, so the exclusion cannot hide a `sys_*` object. Seat read: narrow, as asked.
5. **Prose checked against the diff:** the docblock's recipe reference is recipe 6 ("OAuth or vendor-app token — the server runs the grant") of `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` on main; the README's Credentials section says the administrator registers their own integration key against their deployment's redirect URI, as `clientSource: 'installer'` requires; Callbacks says DocuSign Connect signs its own header, which the `api` door does not verify, so the app polls status.
6. **Out of scope / Acceptance notes:** the live sandbox round trip is NOT MEASURED (the container's proxy answered 403 on `account-d.docusign.com`) and is owed to the acceptance run. A production account's API host is per account (`base_uri` from `/oauth/userinfo`), so this listing is sandbox-first as ruled. `security_findings`: none. `Skills-docs:` not owed.
7. **Landing:** not governed, under 3000 lines ⇒ the seat lands it (`pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`). At MERGED: landing record on #28277, `pm:dispatched` removed (`pm:epic` kept), card thread released.
